description: (0.5.0) A key-revocation for the producer's key is published (receipt created_at) AFTER T, with compromised_since before the node's receipt time. As of T the revocation is not applied (its evidence time > T, RFC-ACDP-0017 §5.3); latest applies it under RFC-ACDP-0014 §7 unchanged.

revocation.revoked_key: the key that signed A and B

did_documents.did:web:agents.example.com:test-producer: one snapshot observed 2026-09-30T00:00:00.000Z with the signing key in assertionMethod

as_of.key_revocation: not-revoked (basis observed, from the 2026-09-30 discovery record)

expected.note: verdict_changed is NOT emitted: revoked_after_as_of already explains the change (RFC-ACDP-0017 §8.4).

scenarios.name: B — no discovery record before T

expected.behavior: Remove the discovery record. As of T, key_revocation is unknown (no admitted record, no admitted revocation) and the chain as-of verdict is unknown; latest is unchanged (refused). Drift includes revoked_after_as_of; it MUST NOT report not-revoked as of T.

scenarios.name: C — compromise boundary after the bodies

expected.behavior: compromised_since = 2026-09-25T00:00:00.000Z: B (receipt 2026-09-10) is pre-compromise in latest (caveat pre_compromise, ok_with_caveats); A (receipt 2026-09-20) is pre-compromise too. Both passes are ok_with_caveats, so drift is []: a stage change that matches no drift kind and leaves the verdict unchanged emits no entry.

notes: Behavioral in this Draft: the verifier builds the described bundle from real signed bodies (or the rcpt-001 / sig-003 test keys), runs verify_chain, and asserts the pinned stage values and verdicts. Pinned verdict digests replace these assertions at promotion (RFC-ACDP-0017 §14).
